title: DOJ's 800+ Defendant Crackdown Singles Out Prison Calls

lines.say: More than eight hundred defendants. More than four hundred cases. The Justice Department calls it its largest-ever crackdown on scammers.
lines.show: More than 800 defendants. More than 400 cases. The Justice Department calls it its largest-ever crackdown on scammers.

lines.say: It singled out one scheme. Fake jury duty calls. In these cases, prosecutors say the callers were Georgia prison gang members.

scene.label: Source: U.S. Department of Justice · press conference · Nov 24, 2026

lines.say: A federal affidavit reproduces part of a handwritten script. It says Georgia officials found it in an inmate's cell.
The F.T.C. counts more than thirty thousand jury duty impostor complaints since twenty twenty-one, with losses above forty million dollars.
lines.show: The FTC counts more than 30,000 jury duty impostor complaints since 2021, with losses above $40 million.

scene.kicker: FTC DATA, AS CITED IN THE AFFIDAVIT
